title: Lossless First-Action Menus for Linear-Reward Planning
abstract: arXiv:2611.19795v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study sequential decision making where an agent reserves a minimum menu of initial actions before multi-objective trade-offs are revealed, followed by unrestricted continuation planning once linear reward weights arrive. We prove that a menu preserves the unrestricted optimal return across all linear scalarizations if and only if its reachable continuations cover all vertices of the full feature polytope. This geometric equivalence yields an output-sensitive algorithm that is fixed-parameter tractable in the vertex count, combining scalar backward induction with oracle-based facet identification. On explicitly layered graphs with unit feature increments, menu verification is coNP-complete and synthesis is complete for the second existential level of the polynomial hierarchy, even under additive loss strictly below one. translated_title: 面向线性奖励规划的无损首动作菜单
translated_abstract: 我们研究一类序贯决策问题：智能体在多目标权衡被揭示之前，预先保留一个最小的初始动作菜单；一旦线性奖励权重到来，便可进行不受限制的后续规划。我们证明，一个菜单能够在所有线性标量化下保持无约束的最优回报，当且仅当其可达的后续状态覆盖了完整特征多面体的所有顶点。这一几何等价性催生了一种输出敏感的算法，该算法关于顶点数量是固定参数可解的，它将标量后向归纳与基于预言机的面识别相结合。在具有单位特征增量的显式分层图上，即使加性损失严格小于1，菜单验证仍是coNP完全的，而菜单合成在多项式层级的第二存在层级上是完全的。在固定维度为二及更高维时，验证是多项式时间的，而合成仍是NP完全的；而在一维情况……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文证明首动作菜单在所有线性标量化下保持最优回报当且仅当其可达后续覆盖特征多面体的全部顶点，据此提出了顶点数固定参数可解的合成算法，并系统刻画了菜单验证与合成的计算复杂性。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that a first-action menu preserves the optimal return under all linear scalarizations if and only if its reachable continuations cover all vertices of the feature polytope, yielding a fixed-parameter tractable synthesis algorithm and a complete complexity characterization of menu verification and synthesis.
